description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Morgana''' grants a [[File:Hybrid resistances icon.png|20px|link=Shield|An icon representing the keyword Shield]] [[:Shield|shield]] to the target allied [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] or herself for 5 seconds, which absorbs incoming magic damage and grants [[File:Cc-immune_icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Cc-Immune]] [[:Crowd control#Immunity|crowd control immunity]] while it holds.
description.text: Active: Morgana grants a shield to the target allied champion or herself for 5 seconds, which absorbs incoming magic damage and grants crowd control immunity while it holds.

leveling.raw:

100 / 155 / 210 / 265 / 320 (+ 70% AP)

notes.raw: * ''Black Shield'' will not resist self nor allied [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control|An icon representing the keyword Crowd control]] [[:Crowd control|crowd control]] (including e.g. an allied [[File:Bard Tempered Fate.png|20xpx|border|link=Bard#Tempered Fate|An icon for Bard's ability Tempered Fate]] [[Bard#Tempered Fate|Tempered Fate]]). * ''Black Shield'' will not resist [[File:Nearsight icon.png|20px|link=Nearsight|An icon representing the keyword Nearsight]] [[:Nearsight|nearsight]]. (unexpected) * ''Black Shield'' negates [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control|An icon representing the keyword Crowd control]] [[:Crowd control|crowd control]] effects before any magic damage is absorbed; even if the shield is broken by an enemy dealing enough damage, its associated disables will not apply. [[Shield#Shield_destruction|Shield-destroying effects]] bypass this however, since they destroy the shield before applying their effects. * Although not considered a ''crowd control'' effect, ''Black Shield'' is special-cased to block [[File:Illaoi OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Illaoi|An icon representing Illaoi]] [[Illaoi|Illaoi's]] [[File:Illaoi Test of Spirit.png|20xpx|border|link=Illaoi#Test of Spirit|An icon for Illaoi's ability Test of Spirit]] [[Illaoi#Test of Spirit|Test of Spirit's]] spirit pull, but does not prevent [[File:Camille OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Camille|An icon representing Camille]] [[Camille|Camille's]] [[File:Camille The Hextech Ultimatum.png|20xpx|border|link=Camille#The Hextech Ultimatum|An icon for Camille's ability The Hextech Ultimatum]] [[Camille#The Hextech Ultimatum|The Hextech Ultimatum]] tether, [[File:Sylas OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Sylas|An icon representing Sylas]] [[Sylas|Sylas']] [[File:Sylas Hijack.png|20xpx|border|link=Sylas#Hijack|An icon for Sylas's ability Hijack]] [[Sylas#Hijack|Hijack]], [[File:Tryndamere OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Tryndamere|An icon representing Tryndamere]] [[Tryndamere|Tryndamere's]] [[File:Tryndamere Mocking Shout.png|20xpx|border|link=Tryndamere#Mocking Shout|An icon for Tryndamere's ability Mocking Shout]] [[Tryndamere#Mocking Shout|Mocking Shout]], [[File:Twisted Fate OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Twisted Fate|An icon representing Twisted Fate]] [[Twisted Fate|Twisted Fate's]] [[File:Twisted Fate Destiny.png|20xpx|border|link=Twisted Fate#Destiny|An icon for Twisted Fate's ability Destiny]] [[Twisted Fate#Destiny|Destiny]]. (unexpected) * ''Black Shield'' does not prevent [[File:Fizz Chum the Waters.png|20xpx|border|link=Fizz#Chum the Waters|An icon for Fizz's ability Chum the Waters]] [[Fizz#Chum the Waters|Chum the Waters]] from attaching. (unexpected) * ''Black Shield'' takes priority over other sources of [[File:Cc-immune_icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Cc-Immune]] [[:Crowd control#Immunity|crowd control immunity]] and those that grant immunity to specific types of crowd control ([[File:Unstoppable icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Displacement immune]] [[:Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|displacement immunity]] and [[File:Slow immune 2.png|20px|link=Slow_resist#Slow Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Slow-immune]] [[:Slow_resist#Slow Immunity|slow immunity]]). * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will take priority over ''Black Shield''. * ''Black Shield'' will always take priority over regular [[File:Hybrid resistances icon.png|20px|link=Shield|An icon representing the keyword Shield]] [[:Shield|shields]]. If used in conjunction with [[Named item effect#Lifeline|Lifeline]], the most recently-applied one will have priority however. * ''Black Shield'' has a [[File:Targeting forgiveness.svg|20px|link=Targeting#Targeting_Forgiveness|An icon representing the keyword Targeting forgiveness]] [[:Targeting#Targeting_Forgiveness|forgiveness radius]] of 175 units.
notes.text:
Black Shield will not resist self nor allied crowd control (including e.g. an allied Tempered Fate).
Black Shield will not resist nearsight. (unexpected)
Black Shield negates crowd control effects before any magic damage is absorbed; even if the shield is broken by an enemy dealing enough damage, its associated disables will not apply. Shield-destroying effects bypass this however, since they destroy the shield before applying their effects.
Although not considered a crowd control effect, Black Shield is special-cased to block Illaoi's Test of Spirit's spirit pull, but does not prevent Camille's The Hextech Ultimatum tether, Sylas' Hijack, Tryndamere's Mocking Shout, Twisted Fate's Destiny. (unexpected)
Black Shield does not prevent Chum the Waters from attaching. (unexpected)
Black Shield takes priority over other sources of crowd control immunity and those that grant immunity to specific types of crowd control ( displacement immunity and slow immunity).
Spell shield will take priority over Black Shield.
Black Shield will always take priority over regular shields. If used in conjunction with Lifeline, the most recently-applied one will have priority however.
Black Shield has a forgiveness radius of 175 units.
